title: Savory Aji Pasta Stir Fry
description: A quick and flavorful Chinese-inspired pasta dish made with aji peppers and a blend of umami flavors.
instructions: Cook the pasta according to the package instructions.
Heat the umami in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the diced aji peppers and cook for 3-4 minutes until tender.
Add the cooked pasta to the skillet and toss to combine with the aji and umami.
Stir in the crunchy and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
